children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on Eternal

Eternal’s 2QFY27 performance was healthy, with Quick Commerce (QCom) NOV growth increasing to 22.2% qoq from 19.1% in 1QFY27 and adjusted EBITDA for Food Delivery growing 24.7% yoy to Rs6.27bn. Growth accelerated for a 5th consecutive quarter to 21.5% yoy, though margin moderated sequentially. Management is seeing strong traction in smaller cities, with OPD ramp-up in line with that in metros along with sustainable unit economics. Blinkit added 308 stores, with store-count now at 2,751; it raised its Mar-27 target to >3,500 stores from 3,000 and Mar-28 target to 5,000 stores. This leads to a ~10% cut in FY27E/28E EBITDA, albeit an increase in FY29/30 estimates by 1%/10%, leading to higher NPV. We believe Blinkit is capitalizing on the QCom opportunity via aggressive network rollout and larger scale feeding into better unit economics. Eternal announced dark.ai, a privacy-first AI assistant aimed at power users, running on frontier open-weight models on Eternal's own infrastructure – pending details on monetization and cost structure, we have a neutral stance.
We believe Eternal is best-positioned to capitalize on the QCom opportunity in India. We retain BUY while raising our TP by 5% to Rs 420.
